subject: plugin/src/bearing/mcp_server.py
candidate_object: BEARING MCP review_candidate MUST NOT block on server-initiated elicitation/create by default; disposition is collected as tool arguments or via bearing review / bearing dispose. elicit:true remains opt-in. Documentation still describes Cursor MCP form elicitation (docs/decisions/shadow/README.md; docs/specs/decision-recovery-skill-spec.md) — that account conflicts with the implementation and is preserved here, not resolved.
temporal_scope: 2026-08-18 onward (commit 83a2455); still current in working tree

evidence.evidence_excerpt: Server-initiated elicitation/create mid-tools/call hangs many Cursor builds when the form UI never completes the round-trip, which freezes the agent loop and looks like Skills autocomplete is broken. Judgment is collected as tool arguments (or via bearing review / chat) instead. Optional elicit: true remains for hosts that fully support forms.

83a2455 Enhance BEARING documentation and introduce setup instructions — same commit replaced initialize capabilities.elicitation with a non-blocking review_candidate path and documented the Cursor hang.
docs/decisions/shadow/README.md still says operators clear the queue via Cursor MCP elicitation (bearing-mcp) and that review_candidate is the same disposition form inside Cursor.

subject: plugin/mcp.json
candidate_object: Plugin-bundled MCP server config MUST use ${PLUGIN_ROOT} (Cursor/Agent Plugins built-in) as cwd, not ${workspaceFolder}. workspaceFolder only applies to a project's .cursor/mcp.json and made MCP feel broken after a plugin-only install.

evidence.evidence_excerpt: Uses ${PLUGIN_ROOT} (Cursor/Agent Plugins built-in), not ${workspaceFolder}. The latter only applies to a project's .cursor/mcp.json and is the wrong variable for plugin-bundled servers — it is what made MCP feel broken after a plugin-only install.
83a2455 Enhance BEARING documentation and introduce setup instructions — introduced plugin/mcp.json generation with cwd ${PLUGIN_ROOT}.

subject: plugin/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json
candidate_object: The Cursor plugin-copy manifest (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json) MUST advertise mcpServers (./mcp.json). Cursor reads this copy after install, not the repo marketplace catalog; without the key, plugin-only and symlink installs never surface MCP.
